issue_request: The Published/Persuasive Jira issue requested correcting the ConsentDirective profile differential for Contract.term.group from invalid contentReference "#term" to the valid target "#Contract.term".

additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini keeps Contract active, has no active [profiles] entry for consentdirective.profile.xml, and records that ConsentDirective became Consent. The retained ConsentDirective profile source still has the corrected reference, and community searches found no later decision that changes the target behavior.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current retained ConsentDirective profile already has contentReference value="#Contract.term" for Contract.term.group, so another edit would be redundant and potentially outside the active profile build surface.
